title: deckstack binding — an event topic mapped to steps
description: Stored as an element of the /bindings ARRAY (state.json), addressed by 'id'. The core vocabulary is closed: set, emit, plugin, exec, sleep. No code fields exist — config is data (R8, ADR-007). exec is fire-and-forget with rlimits (S11); argv[0] must be an absolute path present in /policy/exec/allow and absent from /policy/exec/deny — 'no shell' is enforced by that deny list, not asserted (S3, M1).

path.description: State path evaluated at event time. For app/* events the router first mirrors well-known payloads into state in the same transaction (S7), so /focus is current.

payload.description: Event payload field to read instead of a state path (S7), e.g. "app".

allow_exec.description: Must be true AND the caller's token scope must be admin AND /policy/exec/allow must contain argv[0] AND /policy/exec/deny must not, for any exec step to run.

value.description: Validated against schemas/state.json at the target path.

args.description: Validated against the plugin manifest action's JSON Schema params.

argv.description: Executed directly via execve — NEVER through a shell. S3/M1: argv[0] must match pattern ^/ (schema-enforced via prefixItems) and be in /policy/exec/allow but not /policy/exec/deny (runtime-enforced; deny contains shells/interpreters/wrappers). Fire-and-forget: the daemon does not wait (S11/m5); runaway processes are killed by RLIMIT_CPU.

cwd.description: M2: any absolute path at schema level; confinement to /policy/fs/roots (or /tmp) is enforced at runtime, not by this pattern.
